title: Draftsperson
screening_questions: How many years of digital production experience do you have?
Which of the following statements best describes your right to work in Australia?
Which of the following data visualisation tools are you experienced with?
Which of the following CAD software do you have experience with?
Have you completed a qualification in engineering drafting / engineering design?
Have you worked in a role where you had to identify user needs and form product requirements?
What's your expected annual base salary?
mandatory_unmet: Duties require creating and maintaining 3D models, technical drawings and specifications using SolidWorks and AutoCAD; Marc has not used SolidWorks (facts.json lists AutoCAD, Civil 3D, Revit, Microsoft Office and Google Workspace only)
gaps: Role is product/mechanical drafting (materials, weight limitations, production methods) rather than civil road/drainage work
rationale: Draftsperson title looks entry-friendly, but the core software and discipline are mechanical/product design, not civil.
SolidWorks is named as the 3D modelling tool for the role, which is outside Marc's software list.
Regional Queensland (Allora/Toowoomba), acceptable location on its own.
caution: Rough fit, not an interview forecast; SolidWorks appears in the core duties, so it looks like a real, not just possible, gap.
